Elena Ruiz — Human Factors & Single-Operator Safety said about it: I take from the PSI - Issue 12 (E25) that Snook and Ciriello (SC, meaning psychophysical maximum acceptable push-pull tables) set maximum initial and sustained forces by gender, distance and frequency, and I take from the OCP Data Server Cart Whitepaper (E26) that for 75 percent of people acceptable push is about 36 lb for men and 25 lb for women.
